$Comment: What a participant sees when the night ends with the Blight Warden still standing: the party
was caught or the clock ran out with the fight open, and the round tore the fight down. The
Warden's binding row points its Wiped beat here (Feedback.Wiped), so the words belong to this
A quiet line in the plain tone, on purpose: the round has already told the party how the night
ended, and this only says who kept the gate. It fires once per participant and carries 'share'
and 'seconds' should a line want them.
